title: Training assistant
intro: Ask about your course. Answers come only from the materials your institute has approved, and each answer shows the excerpts it used.
off: The training assistant is not switched on yet.
noMaterials: Your course has no approved materials yet. Ask your trainer.

refused.NO_COURSE: Your course has no approved materials yet. Ask your trainer.
